quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

parent_channels.name: Devotion, Belief, and Sacred Commitment

subchannels.name: Worship and Divine Lordship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worshippers acknowledge a divine lord whose sovereignty, throne, and majesty ground obedience.
subchannels.active_motifs: worship and the worshipped deity `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; lordship and mastery `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; sovereign rule `م ل ك:B003/m01`; royal throne `ع ر ش:B001/m01`; majestic dignity `م ج د:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a coherent hierarchy in which worship answers to lordship, lordship is expressed as sovereignty, and sovereignty is figured by the elevated throne and its majesty.

subchannels.name: Invocation, Oath, and Amen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker calls on the divine name, swears by it, voices a wish, and seeks ratification through “Amen.”
subchannels.active_motifs: divine name in oath and address `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; “Amen” as a request for response `ء م ن:B003/m01`; naming in direct address `س م و:B005/m01`; wished-for fulfillment `و د د:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: These lexical senses assemble a complete prayer act: the invoked name identifies the addressee, desire supplies the petition, and “Amen” asks that the utterance become effective.

subchannels.name: Faith, Promise, and Denial
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promised claim is received with settled belief or rejected through denial and counter-attribution.
subchannels.active_motifs: belief as heart-settling assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; promise that opens expectation `و ع د:B001/m01`; denial that veils truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Promise creates an object of assent, while disbelief and accusation reverse the same epistemic relation by refusing or discrediting what is offered as true.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Fidelity, and Guarded Sanctity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties exchange a binding promise and preserve the relationship by defending its terms, intimacies, and honor.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal pact `و ع د:B004/m01`; covenant and protected alliance `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; preservation of contract, chastity, and sacred bounds `ح ف ظ:B006/m01`; tightened bond `ش د د:B001/m01`; faithful assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene joins agreement to custodianship: a promise becomes durable when its bond is tightened and its personal and communal boundaries are actively guarded.

subchannels.name: Repentance, Forgiveness, and Expiation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wrongdoing is named, the wrongdoer is called back, and the offense is covered so that its punitive effect is removed.
subchannels.active_motifs: invitation to repent `ت و ب:B003/m01`; pardon that shields from consequence `غ ف ر:B002/m01`; expiation that effaces an offense `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; grave sin `ك ب ر:B007/m01`; retributive response `ن ق م:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Covering changes function across the process: sin first incurs punishment, repentance opens return, and forgiveness or expiation covers the offense by protecting the person from its remaining effect.

subchannels.name: Praise, Gratitude, and Devotional Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worth is publicly voiced, remembered as good fame, and intensified into affectionate or cultic devotion.
subchannels.active_motifs: praise and gratitude `ح م د:B001/m01`; verbal glorification `م ج د:B003/m01`; circulating good reputation `س م و:B008/m01`; mutual affection `و د د:B001/m01`; named object of cultic devotion `و د د:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Praise moves from an evaluative utterance to durable social memory and, at its strongest, to attachment centered on a revered name or object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person or community binds itself to a sacred object through worship, assent, praise, promise, fidelity, repentance, and pardon.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; belief and worship at 85:7-11, denial at 85:19, forgiveness and love at 85:14, and majesty at 85:15 and 85:21.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The devotional frame extends into oath formulas, the response “Amen,” treaty language, guarded honor, expiation, reputation, and named cults.

parent_channels.name: Witness, Knowledge, and Linguistic Presence

subchannels.name: Witnessed Presence and Attendance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is physically present, sees what occurs, and participates as attendant, companion, celebrant, or visitor.
subchannels.active_motifs: presence with observation `ش ه د:B001/m01`; seated attendance `ق ع د:B001/m01`; accompanying presence `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; recurring festival attendance `ع و د:B007/m01`; repeated visitation `ع و د:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Witnessing is embodied before it is evidentiary: presence, seating, companionship, festival return, and visitation all place a participant within the event observed.

subchannels.name: Testimony and Comprehensive Knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A knower reaches an encompassing understanding and turns it into decisive testimony or judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony grounded in knowledge `ش ه د:B002/m01`; complete mastery of a report `ق ت ل:B003/m01`; all-sided comprehension `ح و ط:B004/m01`; totality of parts `ك ل ل:B003/m01`; learned authority `ر ب ب:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene progresses from gathering the whole to mastering it and finally declaring it, making testimony the public form of comprehensive knowledge.

subchannels.name: Memorized and Guarded Learning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Words or concepts are received, fixed in the inner faculty, and protected against loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: memorization and retention `ح ف ظ:B002/m01`; gathered recitation and study `ق ر ء:B001/m01`; trusted inner assurance `ء م ن:B001/m01`; the hidden heart or inward thought `ج ن ن:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation supplies ordered verbal material, memory fixes it, and the inward heart becomes both its secure container and the seat of confidence in it.

subchannels.name: Conversation, Report, and News
subchannels.scene_or_process: An event becomes speech, circulates between speakers, and is received as report or narrated precedent.
subchannels.active_motifs: renewed speech and news `ح د ث:B003/m01`; keeping pace in conversation `ج ر ي:B007/m01`; gathered reading or recitation `ق ر ء:B001/m01`; arrival of the report `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; silence that neither begins nor answers `ع و د:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ح د ث` and `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `ج ر ي` at 85:11; `ق ر ء` at 85:21; `ع و د` at 85:13.
subchannels.synthesis: The channel treats discourse as motion: news arrives, speakers move together through an exchange, recitation stabilizes it, and silence marks the breakdown of reciprocal narration.

subchannels.name: Tongue, Articulation, and Fluency
subchannels.scene_or_process: The tongue serves as visible witness by finding the places of the sounds and sustaining intelligible speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: tongue as expressive witness `ش ه د:B005/m01`; fluent placement of letters `ب ل ل:B006/m01`; blunt or exhausted tongue `ك ل ل:B001/m01`; speechlessness `ع و د:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Articulation makes inward content externally legible, while dullness and silence supply the contrasting failure states of the same speech mechanism.

subchannels.name: Grammar, Interrogation, and Deixis
subchannels.scene_or_process: Function words locate a referent, ask about it, connect a clause to it, or shift the discourse to a new proposition.
subchannels.active_motifs: relative connector “ذو” `ذ و و:B002/m01`; demonstrative pointer `ذ و و:B003/m01`; interrogative or relative “ماذا” `ذ و و:B004/m01`; grammatical objects and complements `ف ع ل:B007/m01`; particle of qualification “رب” `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; adversative-resumptive “بل” `ب ل ل:B008/m01`; posterior or alternative perspective `و ر ي:B006/m01`; lower spatial relation `ت ح ت:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs form a discourse-control system: pointing establishes the referent, interrogation opens a slot, grammar assigns its relation, and particles redirect, qualify, or spatially orient the clause.

subchannels.name: Naming and Identity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person, deity, lineage, or place is fixed and socially recognized through a name or designation.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming and name equivalence `س م و:B005/m01`; possessor or attributed identity `ذ و و:B001/m01`; personal and tribal names `ج ن د:B004/m01`; personal name “Ṣāliḥ” `ص ل ح:B004/m01`; place and poet names `ن ه ر:B007/m01`; branded identifying mark `خ د د:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Names, possessive attributions, genealogical labels, place-names, and bodily marks all make identity durable by attaching a publicly retrievable sign to its bearer.

subchannels.name: Reputation, Anecdote, and Exemplar
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person’s deeds become repeated public speech and settle into praise, blame, biography, or proverb.
subchannels.active_motifs: becoming an anecdote `ح د ث:B004/m01`; circulating good fame `س م و:B008/m01`; verbal commemoration `م ج د:B003/m01`; evaluated character `ف ع ل:B002/m01`; recurring mention `ع و د:B007/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Conduct is converted into narrative capital: repeated telling makes the subject exemplary, and praise or blame determines the form in which the name persists.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons, events, and referents are made present to mind or community through attendance, testimony, memory, report, articulation, grammar, and naming.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; witnesses at 85:3, 85:7, 85:9, the report at 85:17, the recited text at 85:21, and its preservation at 85:22.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel reaches ritual attendance, weddings, memorization, phonetics, interrogatives, relative and demonstrative reference, greetings, proper names, seals, and reputation.

parent_channels.name: Sovereignty, Rank, and Contest

subchannels.name: Ownership and Sovereign Rule
subchannels.scene_or_process: An owner exercises disposal over property and a ruler governs subjects from an elevated seat.
subchannels.active_motifs: possession and disposal `م ل ك:B002/m01`; kingship and political sovereignty `م ل ك:B003/m01`; lordly ownership `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; royal throne `ع ر ش:B001/m01`; stable structure of power `ع ر ش:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Property and rule form one graded scene, moving from control of a thing to governance of a people and finally to the throne as the structure that sustains authority.

subchannels.name: Majesty, Eminence, and Dignity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or institution rises above peers through strength, inherited standing, and publicly acknowledged dignity.
subchannels.active_motifs: majestic honor `م ج د:B001/m01`; elevation and high repute `س م و:B001/m01`; leadership and noble standing `ك ب ر:B005/m01`; grandeur and rightful greatness `ك ب ر:B006/m01`; strength opposed to humiliation `ع ز ز:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Physical elevation, social precedence, strength, and praised grandeur converge on a single status transformation from lowliness to recognized dignity.

subchannels.name: Primacy, Leadership, and Command
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leader goes first, is mentioned first, directs a crew or herd, and brings action to effect.
subchannels.active_motifs: chief mentioned first `ب د ء:B003/m01`; headship and teaching authority `ك ب ر:B005/m01`; captain of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; leading animal or guide `م ل ك:B008/m01`; decisive effective person `ء ت ي:B013/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The same invariant of functional precedence links the named chief, ship captain, herd leader, and effective agent: each occupies the forward position that organizes followers.

subchannels.name: Competition, Boasting, and Victory
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rivals match themselves, boast of superiority, overpower an opponent, and claim prestige or success.
subchannels.active_motifs: rivalry and competitive matching `س م و:B007/m01`; overpowering the opponent `ع ز ز:B002/m01`; competitive domination `ك ب ر:B011/m01`; boasting through glory `م ج د:B002/m01`; victory and deliverance `ف و ز:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Competition escalates from comparison to boast, then to overpowering and possession of the winning outcome, while glory preserves the victory as status.

subchannels.name: Administration, Delegation, and Tribute
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler assigns an office, sends an agent, exacts revenue, and requires continued performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding governmental office `ع م ل:B003/m01`; delegated agent or guarantor `ج ر ي:B003/m01`; tax, tribute, or levy `ء ت ي:B008/m01`; tithe governed as covenant `ر ب ب:B011/m02`; constancy in official duty `ح ف ظ:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ع م ل` and `ج ر ي` at 85:11; `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `ر ب ب` at 85:12; `ح ف ظ` at 85:22.
subchannels.synthesis: Office turns authority into procedure: appointment creates the agent, tribute creates the obligation, and habitual preservation keeps the institution functioning.

subchannels.name: Social Strata, Humiliation, and Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Groups are ranked, some occupy a low stratum, and submission is displayed through lowered posture.
subchannels.active_motifs: social class or faction `خ د د:B005/m01`; grouped strata `ك ل ل:B009/m01`; disregarded lower ranks `ت ح ت:B002/m01`; ignoble or cowardly status `ق ع د:B013/m01`; bowed bodily submission `ك ف ر:B014/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `خ د د` at 85:4; `ك ل ل` at 85:9; `ت ح ت` at 85:11; `ق ع د` at 85:6; `ك ف ر` at 85:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Rank is encoded both collectively and bodily: classes occupy relative levels, while lowering the head or chest performs subordination within that hierarchy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Power is organized as ownership, rule, elevated status, leadership, competition, administration, and submission.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; divine might at 85:8, sovereignty at 85:9, severe power at 85:12, and throne and majesty at 85:15.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hierarchy extends to captains, animal leaders, bureaucrats, tax collectors, social strata, competitive boasting, cowardice, and ritualized submission.

parent_channels.name: Moral Agency, Deception, and Judgment

subchannels.name: Intentional Action and Causation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A willing agent initiates an act, brings a new state into being, and produces an effect.
subchannels.active_motifs: enacted occurrence `ف ع ل:B001/m01`; purposive work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; initiation `ب د ء:B001/m01`; event arising after nonexistence `ح د ث:B001/m01`; will and purpose `ر و د:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Will supplies direction, initiation opens the process, work carries it out, and the resulting event is the changed state caused by the agent.

subchannels.name: Character, Virtue, and Good Conduct
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated actions reveal a person’s disposition and are judged as fitting, beneficial, generous, or blameworthy.
subchannels.active_motifs: noble or base character expressed in action `ف ع ل:B002/m01`; rectitude opposed to corruption `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; aptitude for good `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; tested approval `ح م د:B002/m01`; generosity of character `ع ذ ب:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene treats conduct as the visible test of disposition: fitting and reparative action earns approval, while its opposite exposes moral defect.

subchannels.name: Fabrication, Forgery, and False Attribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker constructs speech, poetry, or an account without a true model and presents the product as credible.
subchannels.active_motifs: invented fabrication `ف ع ل:B004/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; imputing falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; manufactured report `ح د ث:B003/m02`; imposed poetic pattern `ق ر ء:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Craft becomes deception when formal construction is detached from truth: a patterned utterance is made, circulated as news, and defended by redirecting the charge of falsehood.

subchannels.name: Seduction and Misdirection
subchannels.scene_or_process: One party decorates an object or proposition, contests another’s will, and draws that person away from an intended course.
subchannels.active_motifs: diversion from the right course `ف ت ن:B003/m01`; contested persuasion `ر و د:B002/m01`; seductive display `ب ر ج:B003/m01`; coquettish movement or pleading `ق ت ل:B004/m01`; deceptive impulse `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Display attracts attention, persuasion contests volition, and misdirection changes the target’s course, with bodily coquetry and inward deceit supplying parallel mechanisms.

subchannels.name: Testing, Ordeal, and Crisis
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or material is exposed to severe pressure so that quality, endurance, or allegiance becomes visible.
subchannels.active_motifs: assaying metal or testing a person `ف ت ن:B001/m01`; ordeal and affliction `ف ت ن:B004/m01`; force and resilience `ش د د:B002/m01`; burdensome difficulty `ع ز ز:B005/m01`; crisis or momentous event `ي و م:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ف ت ن` at 85:10; `ش د د` at 85:12; `ع ز ز` at 85:8; `ي و م` at 85:2.
subchannels.synthesis: The assay supplies the mechanism, severity supplies the pressure, and crisis supplies the setting in which hidden quality is separated from failure.

subchannels.name: Censure, Restraint, and Abstention
subchannels.scene_or_process: An objection is voiced, the subject is rebuked, and an action or appetite is halted.
subchannels.active_motifs: disapproval and grievance `ن ق م:B001/m01`; forceful verbal rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`; withholding, weaning, or abstention `ع ذ ب:B003/m01`; sitting out an action `ق ع د:B002/m01`; preventing grazing `ع ر ش:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment first appears as dissatisfaction, becomes speech in rebuke, and becomes behavioral control through withholding, abstention, or enforced inactivity.

subchannels.name: Punishment, Ruin, and Mortal Outcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: Condemned action is answered by pain, overpowering enclosure, destruction, severe illness, or death.
subchannels.active_motifs: punitive retaliation `ن ق م:B002/m01`; inflicted suffering `ع ذ ب:B005/m01`; engulfing defeat and destruction `ح و ط:B006/m01`; fatal calamity `ء ت ي:B011/m01`; death as departure `ف و ز:B002/m01`; annihilating removal `ل و ح:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Punishment is represented as a closing field of force: pain and calamity progressively surround the target until capacity, property, health, or life itself is removed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Intentional action acquires ethical character, may be falsified or misdirected, is tested under pressure, and receives censure, restraint, pardon, or punishment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; deeds at 85:7, faith and blame at 85:8, trial and punishment at 85:10, severe retribution at 85:12, and unconstrained action and will at 85:16.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes craftsmanship as a metaphor for fabrication, seductive display, metal assaying, weaning and abstention, verbal rebuke, and destruction figured as total enclosure.

parent_channels.name: Conflict, Coercion, and Survival

subchannels.name: Assault and Warfare
subchannels.scene_or_process: Organized forces launch a violent charge and sustain reciprocal combat.
subchannels.active_motifs: forceful seizure or attack `ب ط ش:B001/m01`; charging the enemy `ش د د:B003/m01`; reciprocal fighting `ق ت ل:B011/m01`; allied army `ج ن د:B001/m01`; war and civil strife `ف ت ن:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب ط ش` and `ش د د` at 85:12; `ق ت ل` at 85:4; `ج ن د` at 85:17; `ف ت ن` at 85:10.
subchannels.synthesis: The army supplies collective agency, the charge initiates contact, violent seizure marks tactical force, and sustained reciprocal fighting turns assault into war.

subchannels.name: Feud, Turmoil, and Agitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hostility spreads through a group, disturbs minds and speech, and fragments common judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: interpersonal enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; confusion and clamorous mixing `ب ل ل:B009/m01`; factional conflict `ف ت ن:B006/m01`; bodily tremor `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; restless movement `ر و د:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن و ر` at 85:5; the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `ف ت ن` at 85:10; `ء ر ض` at 85:9; `ر و د` at 85:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Conflict is traced from social enmity into its embodied and communicative effects: agitation, confused speech, tremor, and inability to settle.

subchannels.name: Capture, Domination, and Incapacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A stronger party grasps a target, attaches it to itself, and closes off escape or independent action.
subchannels.active_motifs: seizure and possession `ب ل ل:B004/m01`; overpowering a rival `ع ز ز:B002/m01`; violent grasp `ب ط ش:B001/m01`; engulfing defeat `ح و ط:B006/m01`; disabling inability to rise `ق ع د:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `ع ز ز` at 85:8; `ب ط ش` at 85:12; `ح و ط` at 85:20; `ق ع د` at 85:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Domination is a sequence from taking hold to enclosing the captured party and finally reducing that party’s capacity to move or resist.

subchannels.name: Reconciliation and Truce
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opposed parties cease hostility, exchange promises, and preserve a negotiated social peace.
subchannels.active_motifs: reconciliation after estrangement `ص ل ح:B002/m01`; reciprocal agreement `و ع د:B004/m01`; guarded covenant `ح ف ظ:B006/m01`; witnessed attendance `ش ه د:B001/m01`; social compatibility `ص ح ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Peace is not mere absence of fighting; it is a witnessed agreement whose terms are made compatible and then actively protected.

subchannels.name: Wilderness Crossing and Survival
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler enters a waterless, dangerous expanse and survives by orientation, competition with hazard, and control of scarce water.
subchannels.active_motifs: perilous wilderness passage `ف و ز:B003/m01`; striving against peers or terrain `س م و:B007/m01`; incoming flood from elsewhere `ء ت ي:B005/m01`; water that secures a camp’s existence `م ل ك:B007/m01`; visible route marker `ن و ر:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The paradoxical “place of survival” is completed by practical motifs: the crossing is dangerous, markers guide movement, and possession of water determines whether the party can continue.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Opposed parties threaten, attack, seize, divide, reconcile, or traverse danger in pursuit of survival and advantage.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; killing and the trench community at 85:4, persecution at 85:10, overpowering force at 85:12, and armies at 85:17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The conflict frame reaches competitive prestige, emotional feud, capture and attachment, truces, wilderness crossings, and water as the resource that makes a dangerous journey possible.

parent_channels.name: Social Belonging, Care, and Exchange

subchannels.name: Companionship and Amity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons remain together through compatible attachment, mutual affection, and repeated shared presence.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship and sustained association `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; making one thing accompany another `ص ح ب:B004/m01`; mutual affection `و د د:B001/m01`; social attachment `ب ل ل:B004/m02`; witnessed presence `ش ه د:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Companionship is represented as a durable fit: parties stay present, attach to one another, and convert proximity into reciprocal affection.

subchannels.name: Assembly, Community, and Collective Strata
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individuals gather into an organized body that may contain allied forces, a majority, factions, and ranked groups.
subchannels.active_motifs: allied collectivity `ج ن د:B001/m01`; mass of the people `ج ن ن:B013/m01`; numerous community `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; class or faction `خ د د:B005/m01`; grouped bodies `ك ل ل:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The same assembling process yields both solidarity and differentiation: a mass becomes a community, while internal classes and factions determine its structure.

subchannels.name: Lineage, Ancestry, and Inheritance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Social identity and property move through descent, proximity to an ancestor, collateral kin, and grandchildren.
subchannels.active_motifs: closeness in genealogy `ق ع د:B012/m01`; collateral inheritance `ك ل ل:B004/m01`; descendant through the son `و ر ي:B007/m01`; child becoming an adult companion `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; attributed kinship `ذ و و:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ق ع د` at 85:6; `ك ل ل` at 85:9; `و ر ي` at 85:20; `ص ح ب` at 85:4; the `ذَات/ذُو` tokens at 85:1, 85:5, 85:15.
subchannels.synthesis: Genealogy defines both social nearness and legal succession, linking the named possessor to ancestors, collateral heirs, maturing children, and later descendants.

subchannels.name: Childcare and Dependents
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household raises a child or stepchild and carries the material burden of those unable to provide for themselves.
subchannels.active_motifs: stepchild, nurse, or guardian `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; dependent or ward `ك ل ل:B002/m01`; household wealth and dependents `ق ر ء:B013/m01`; child reaching companionable adulthood `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; gradual upbringing `ر ب ب:B002/m02`.

subchannels.name: Guardianship, Escort, and Protective Care

subchannels.synthesis: Escort supplies presence, vigilance supplies awareness, and encircling care supplies intervention, making protection an active relationship rather than a static barrier.

subchannels.name: Gift, Hospitality, and Recurring Benefaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A benefactor presents goods, maintains a flow of support, and receives gratitude or reputation for generosity.

parent_channels.name: Enclosure, Habitation, and Route

subchannels.name: Concealment, Veil, and Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: An object is hidden from sense by being veiled, covered, placed behind something, or absorbed into darkness.

subchannels.synthesis: Concealment ranges from material covering to darkness and semantic indirection, but each operation removes the object from direct access while leaving it present behind a screen.

subchannels.name: Shelter, Canopy, and Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A raised cover creates an inhabitable protected interior, sometimes centered on a hearth.
subchannels.active_motifs: roof, awning, or animal shelter `ع ر ش:B002/m01`; light tent or protective screen `ك ل ل:B006/m01`; hiding place or refuge `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; fireplace or hearth `و ق د:B003/m01`; fixed residence `ع ر ش:B012/m01`.

subchannels.synthesis: Roof and screen define the boundary, refuge gives the enclosure its protective function, and the hearth turns it from mere cover into an occupied dwelling.

subchannels.name: Wall, Bastion, and Perimeter
subchannels.scene_or_process: A place is defended or delimited by an encircling wall, fortified tower, covered pass, or crown-like boundary.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical encirclement and walling `ح و ط:B001/m01`; fortified tower or castle `ب ر ج:B001/m01`; covered mountain pass or low wall `ك ف ر:B013/m01`; encircling crown or border `ك ل ل:B005/m01`; protective shield `ج ن ن:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs share a perimeter function: tower, wall, crown, pass, and shield arrange material around a vulnerable center to mark and defend it.

subchannels.name: Residence, Permanence, and Homecoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person settles, remains attached to a place, and treats it as the endpoint to which return is directed.
subchannels.active_motifs: clinging to the ground `ء ر ض:B006/m01`; dwelling and duration `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; fixed settlement `ع ر ش:B012/m01`; taking up residence `ق ع د:B016/m01`; destination and homecoming `ع و د:B002/m01`; persistent attachment `ب ل ل:B004/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض` at 85:9; `ر ب ب` at 85:12; `ع ر ش` at 85:15; `ق ع د` at 85:6; `ع و د` at 85:13; the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21.
subchannels.synthesis: Groundedness becomes social and temporal permanence: remaining creates residence, attachment gives it continuity, and return defines it as home.

subchannels.name: Roads, Tracks, and Practiced Ways
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traversable way is laid out by route, trace, repeated use, and a method that keeps movement from losing direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: inhabited thoroughfare `ء ت ي:B010/m01`; road trace or rut `خ د د:B006/m01`; worked road `ع م ل:B011/m01`; customary way `ج ر ي:B002/m01`; method or pattern `ق ر ء:B011/m01`; central line of road or valley `م ل ك:B006/m01`; track that preserves its trace `ح ف ظ:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `خ د د` at 85:4; `ع م ل` and `ج ر ي` at 85:11; `ق ر ء` at 85:21; `م ل ك` at 85:9; `ح ف ظ` at 85:22.
subchannels.synthesis: A route is both physical and procedural: repeated passage leaves a trace, trace becomes a road, and the road becomes a model for method and disciplined practice.

subchannels.name: Foundations, Lower Levels, and Support
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upper structure rests on a lower layer, base, or ground that carries its weight.
subchannels.active_motifs: foundation or structural base `ق ع د:B007/m01`; lower spatial region `ت ح ت:B001/m01`; ground opposed to sky `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; structural firmness `م ل ك:B001/m01`; fixed frame `ع ر ش:B004/m02`.

subchannels.synthesis: The lower region is not merely beneath; it is the load-bearing support whose firmness allows the visible structure above it to stand.

subchannels.name: Trenches, Wells, and Excavated Channels
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earth is cut to form a trench, well, or watercourse and then reinforced so that the excavation can function.
subchannels.active_motifs: long sunken trench `خ د د:B002/m01`; newly dug well `ب د ء:B008/m01`; unfinished well `ق ع د:B015/m01`; timbered wellhead and water station `ع ر ش:B004/m01`; river channel cut through earth `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; directed watercourse `ء ت ي:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Cutting creates the void, timber and foundation stabilize it, and directed flow converts the excavation into infrastructure rather than a mere hole.

subchannels.name: Migration, Foreignness, and Relocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person leaves one land, enters another as an outsider, and negotiates exposure, route, and settlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: foreigner among another people `ء ت ي:B006/m01`; outsider “son of the land” `ء ر ض:B004/m01`; departure from one land to another `ب د ء:B005/m01`; exposure or confrontation on arrival `ء ر ض:B007/m01`; pedestrian traveler `ع م ل:B012/m01`; old or ancestral road `ع و د:B009/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `ء ر ض` at 85:9; `ب د ء` and `ع و د` at 85:13; `ع م ل` at 85:11.
subchannels.synthesis: Migration joins departure, route, and arrival to a social role: the traveler crosses by an inherited way but enters the destination marked as foreign.

parent_channels.name: Celestial, Atmospheric, and Calendrical Order

subchannels.name: Sky, Ceiling, and Open Atmosphere
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upper cover arches over the ground while open air and layered cloud occupy the interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky, ceiling, and overhanging upper region `س م و:B004/m01`; open air between earth and sky `ل و ح:B004/m01`; layered cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; uncovered exposure to the sky `ع ذ ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Sky functions simultaneously as cover and spatial field: cloud layers occupy its open interval, while exposure is defined by the absence of any intervening shelter.

subchannels.name: Stars, Constellations, and Celestial Markers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurrent star groups divide and mark the upper field for orientation and timekeeping.
subchannels.active_motifs: celestial stations and constellations `ب ر ج:B002/m01`; named star throne or cluster `ع ر ش:B008/m01`; three-star lunar station `غ ف ر:B006/m01`; astronomical indicator `ش ه د:B008/m01`; lunar crown or station `ك ل ل:B005/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Constellations, star-thrones, lunar stations, and indicators convert the sky from undifferentiated height into a legible system of positions.

subchannels.name: Daylight, Sunrise, and the Height of Day
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light opens the day, rises toward its strongest point, and then passes into concealment.
subchannels.active_motifs: bounded daylight `ي و م:B001/m01`; opened day and brightness `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; high noon or elevated day `ش د د:B005/m01`; prime of day `ك ب ر:B013/m01`; sunset or darkness that covers `ك ف ر:B002/m02`; course of sun or light `ج ر ي:B001/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ي و م` at 85:2; `ن ه ر` and `ج ر ي` at 85:11; `ش د د` at 85:12; `ك ب ر` at 85:11; `ك ف ر` at 85:19.
subchannels.synthesis: Day is a cycle of opening, ascent, culmination, motion, and covering, so temporal passage is rendered as a changing geometry of light.

subchannels.name: Cloud, Rain, Flood, and Seasonal Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Atmospheric intensity accumulates as cloud, produces rain or a foreign flood, and alternates with severe seasonal heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: violent rain or flood `ع ز ز:B008/m01`; flood arriving from another country `ء ت ي:B005/m01`; rain-bearing cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m02`; extreme summer heat `و ق د:B004/m01`; sky and rain source `س م و:B004/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Weather is organized by force and transfer: cloud gathers overhead, precipitation gains intensity, floodwater crosses territorial boundaries, and heat marks the opposing seasonal extreme.

subchannels.name: Calendar, Appointment, and Festival Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promised time becomes a calendrical appointment that communities repeatedly attend as festival or rite.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed time or place `و ع د:B003/m01`; month of suspended travel `ق ع د:B014/m01`; recurring festival `ع و د:B007/m01`; ritual attendance `ش ه د:B001/m02`; bounded duration `ي و م:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Promise fixes expectation, the calendar fixes its time, and repeated communal attendance converts the appointment into a festival cycle.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The upper world organizes space and time through sky, stars, daylight, cloud, rain, flood, season, calendar, and recurring festival.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; sky and constellations at 85:1, the promised day at 85:2, firelight at 85:5, heavens and earth at 85:9, and flowing rivers at 85:11.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes ceilings and open air, lunar stations, Pleiades-like star groups, the rising strength of day, foreign floodwater, summer heat, ritual months, and festival attendance.

parent_channels.name: Fire, Radiance, and Visible Transformation

subchannels.name: Ignition, Kindling, and Fuel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A latent spark is struck, fed with fuel, and intensified into sustained combustion.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden fire emerging from a firestick `و ر ي:B002/m01`; active ignition and burning `و ق د:B001/m01`; fuel or kindling `و ق د:B002/m01`; wood prolific in fire `م ج د:B005/m01`; rapid flare or fervor `و ق د:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `و ر ي` at 85:20; `و ق د` and `ن و ر` at 85:5; `م ج د` at 85:15, 85:21.
subchannels.synthesis: The mechanism begins with fire stored in wood, proceeds through striking and feeding, and culminates in a flame whose vigor can also figure emotional or martial fervor.

subchannels.name: Blaze, Scorching, and Material Change
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flame acts on a body or material, causing pain, blackening, discoloration, or loss of form.
subchannels.active_motifs: consuming blaze `ح ر ق:B002/m01`; burning and blackening by fire `ف ت ن:B002/m01`; visible alteration by heat `ل و ح:B002/m01`; stinging or burning pain `ح ر ق:B003/m01`; trial by heat `ف ت ن:B001/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ح ر ق` and `ف ت ن` at 85:10; `ل و ح` at 85:22.
subchannels.synthesis: Heat is both destructive and diagnostic: it burns and discolors, but the resulting visible change also reveals what the material or person can withstand.

subchannels.name: Fire Tools and Hearth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire is produced and contained through a striker, fire-bearing implement, hearth, and suitable wood.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire-making implement `ح ر ق:B008/m01`; hearth or fireplace `و ق د:B003/m01`; successful firestick and practical aid `و ر ي:B003/m01`; wooden or incense stick `ع و د:B010/m02`; fire-rich wood `م ج د:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: This is the technical counterpart of combustion: selected material, striker, and hearth cooperate to turn potential heat into a controlled domestic flame.

subchannels.name: Radiance, Gleam, and Flash
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light appears abruptly or continuously as illumination, polished gleam, lightning, or a flash compared with a smile.
subchannels.active_motifs: illumination and brightness `ن و ر:B001/m01`; visible gleam `ل و ح:B001/m01`; fire-like sparkle `و ق د:B006/m01`; flashing smile or lightning `ك ل ل:B011/m01`; lightning-like surge `ح ر ق:B005/m01`.

subchannels.synthesis: Fire, lightning, polished surfaces, and teeth share a sudden visibility signature, allowing physical radiance to extend naturally into beauty and expression.

subchannels.name: Visibility, Indicator, and Farsight
subchannels.scene_or_process: An elevated or conspicuous form becomes a sign that can be detected from afar and used to infer a hidden state.
subchannels.active_motifs: high visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`; diagnostic sign or marker `ش ه د:B008/m02`; long-distance vision `ش ي ء:B003/m01`; broad clear eye `ب ر ج:B004/m01`; route beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Height and contrast make the sign visible, farsight detects it, and interpretation converts appearance into evidence about time, quality, route, or condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stored energy is kindled, becomes flame and heat, alters material, and yields light, flash, mark, or visible sign.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; fire and fuel at 85:5, burning punishment at 85:10, and the visible tablet at 85:22.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The fire scene extends to assaying, firesticks, hearths, scorching flavor and skin, lightning, smiles compared with flashes, polished brilliance, road signs, and bodily indicators.

parent_channels.name: Water, Nourishment, and Cultivated Growth

subchannels.name: Streams, Irrigation, and Directed Flow
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water moves through a natural or engineered channel and is directed toward a field, basin, or settlement.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing water `ج ر ي:B001/m01`; river cut through the land `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; guided watercourse `ء ت ي:B004/m01`; timbered water station `ع ر ش:B004/m01`; abundant water securing habitation `م ل ك:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ج ر ي` and `ن ه ر` at 85:11; `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `ع ر ش` at 85:15; `م ل ك` at 85:9.
subchannels.synthesis: Natural flow becomes infrastructure when a channel captures it, a station controls it, and the resulting supply makes cultivation and settlement possible.

subchannels.name: Dampness, Dew, and Wet Air
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moisture settles on surfaces, remains in containers, and moves gently through wind or air.
subchannels.active_motifs: wetness and dew `ب ل ل:B001/m01`; gentle moist movement `ر و د:B005/m01`; rain-bearing sky `س م و:B004/m02`; open atmospheric interval `ل و ح:B004/m01`; water arriving as yield `ء ت ي:B007/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is one of low-intensity water transfer: moisture is carried in air, settles as dew, and remains as the wet residue that sustains living surfaces.

subchannels.name: Sweet Water, Algae, and Drinkable Supply
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community secures abundant potable water whose surface condition and taste determine its usefulness.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundant sweet water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; sweet palatable liquid `ع ذ ب:B001/m01`; water that secures subsistence `م ل ك:B007/m01`; algae covering water `ص ح ب:B007/m01`; mixing water into strong drink `ق ت ل:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر ب ب` at 85:12; `ع ذ ب` at 85:10; `م ل ك` at 85:9; `ص ح ب` at 85:4; `ق ت ل` at 85:4.
subchannels.synthesis: Water is evaluated as a managed provision: quantity enables settlement, sweetness enables drinking, surface growth signals condition, and dilution moderates stronger liquids.

subchannels.name: Satiety, Abundance, and Abstinence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food or pasture fills a body or container, while fasting, thirst, and scarcity define the opposing state.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily or pastoral fullness `م ج د:B004/m01`; broad provision in food and drink `ب ر ج:B009/m01`; filled sack or full volume `ق ع د:B011/m01`; refusal or inability to eat and drink `ع ذ ب:B002/m01`; thickened sustaining food `ر ب ب:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Fullness is legible in bodies, pasture, and containers, while abstinence and thirst expose the same nourishment system through deprivation.

subchannels.name: Garden, Palm, Trellis, and Blossom
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fertile ground receives seed, supports young palms and trees, and carries growth from covered shoot to flower.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; dense vigorous vegetation `ج ن ن:B011/m01`; fertile planted ground `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; palm seedlings `ش ي ء:B006/m01`; blossom `ن و ر:B004/m01`; supporting trellis `ع ر ش:B003/m01`; seed-covering cultivation `ك ف ر:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivation is a staged mechanism: earth receives covered seed, the shoot emerges, support directs its growth, foliage encloses the garden, and flowering marks maturity.

subchannels.name: Plant Exudates, Honeycomb, and Aromatics
subchannels.scene_or_process: Trees and flowers produce sweet or aromatic substances that are gathered, thickened, stored, or consumed.
subchannels.active_motifs: sweet tree gum or exudate `غ ف ر:B007/m01`; honey held in wax `ش ه د:B007/m01`; fruit sheath or calyx `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; camphor and fragrant plant `ك ف ر:B011/m01`; thick syrup or food preparation `ر ب ب:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Protective plant coverings become reservoirs of value: calyx, bark, and wax hold sweet or aromatic matter that can be collected and processed.

subchannels.name: Gruel, Syrup, and Prepared Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Raw liquid and grain are heated or thickened into sustaining food and adjusted for taste or strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: thick gruel or soup `ح ر ق:B009/m01`; thickened syrup or corrective mixture `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; palatable sweetness `ع ذ ب:B001/m01`; moderated drink `ق ت ل:B007/m01`; fullness produced by provision `م ج د:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Heating, thickening, sweetening, and dilution form a small food technology whose outcome is palatable nourishment and satiety.

parent_channels.name: Generation, Life Stages, and Bodily Health

subchannels.name: Mating, Estrus, and Animal Sexuality
subchannels.scene_or_process: A female enters estrus, a male signals and mounts, and observers test whether mating or conception has occurred.
subchannels.active_motifs: female seeking the male `ء ت ي:B012/m01`; estrous cycle and mating test `ق ر ء:B009/m01`; stallion mounting the herd `س م و:B003/m01`; bellow before sexual charge `و ع د:B005/m01`; copulation `ح ر ق:B006/m01`; difficult milk and reproductive effort `ع ز ز:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Cycle, signal, approach, mounting, and post-mating inspection form a complete reproductive behavior sequence rather than a generic sexuality cluster.

subchannels.name: Womb and Gestation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fetus is enclosed in the womb and carried together with blood and other concealed contents until birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: fetus hidden in the abdomen `ج ن ن:B007/m01`; womb gathering fetus or blood `ق ر ء:B003/m01`; child continuing through descent `و ر ي:B007/m01`; recent maternity `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; maternal womb `ع ذ ب:B009/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Enclosure is physiological here: the womb gathers and hides developing life, links it to descent, and moves toward the state of recent maternity.

subchannels.name: Birth Residues, Puberty, and Menopause
subchannels.scene_or_process: Birth and sexual maturation are marked by blood, afterbirth, discharge, menstruation, and its eventual cessation.
subchannels.active_motifs: afterbirth and maturation discharge `ش ه د:B006/m01`; postpartum matter from the womb `ع ذ ب:B009/m01`; expelled fetal or blood material `ق ر ء:B003/m02`; delayed or retained reproductive cycle `ق ر ء:B004/m01`; recent birth and milk `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; cessation of menstruation and marriageability `ق ع د:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reproductive time is read through bodily signs, from birth residue and first maturation discharge to cyclic retention and the later cessation of fertility.

subchannels.name: Youth, Maidenhood, Adulthood, and Aging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person moves from fresh youth through mature strength into experienced old age.
subchannels.active_motifs: youthful freshness `ح د ث:B002/m01`; beginning of youth `ج ن ن:B014/m01`; young maiden `ر و د:B008/m01`; completion of adult strength `ش د د:B004/m01`; child becoming an adult companion `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; aged animal or experienced elder `ع و د:B008/m01`; old age `ك ب ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Life stage is defined relationally as well as biologically: freshness becomes attractiveness, strength becomes adult competence, and age becomes companionship and accumulated experience.

subchannels.name: Chest, Hip, Limb, and Foreleg Anatomy
subchannels.scene_or_process: The body is mapped through load-bearing and moving structures of chest, hip, foot, and limb.
subchannels.active_motifs: chest bones and rib ends `ج ن ن:B016/m01`; chest or breast `ك ل ل:B007/m01`; prominent breast `ق ع د:B011/m02`; hip points `ع ز ز:B010/m01`; hip tendon `ح ر ق:B007/m01`; neck and upper foot structures `ع ر ش:B007/m01`; working limbs or eye `ع م ل:B010/m01`; camel foreleg gait `ء ت ي:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a functional anatomy: chest and ribs stabilize the trunk, hip and foot transfer force, and limbs or forelegs enact movement.

subchannels.name: Flesh, Marrow, and Gauntness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily condition is read from the amount and distribution of flesh, fat, and marrow.
subchannels.active_motifs: full flesh, fat, and marrow `و ر ي:B004/m01`; wasted or contracted flesh `خ د د:B003/m01`; bodily fullness `م ج د:B004/m02`; hard compact flesh `ع ز ز:B007/m02`; aged residual strength `ع و د:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Plumpness and gauntness are opposing surface signatures of internal reserves, with marrow, firmness, and remaining strength indicating bodily viability.

subchannels.name: Lung Disease, Infection, and Epidemic
subchannels.scene_or_process: Illness penetrates the chest or wound, produces pus or decay, spreads through a place, and overwhelms the patient.
subchannels.active_motifs: lung or internal suppurating disease `و ر ي:B001/m01`; infected ulcer `ء ر ض:B011/m01`; regional epidemic `ق ر ء:B008/m01`; overpowering illness `ع ز ز:B009/m01`; fatal calamity or severe sickness `ء ت ي:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from local lesion to internal infection and then to spatial spread, while overpowering force describes the patient’s declining control.

subchannels.name: Recovery, Relapse, and Convalescent Visit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A patient improves, is revisited and cared for, or falls back into a worse condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: recovery and restored health `ب ل ل:B003/m01`; relapse of wound or disease `غ ف ر:B004/m01`; repeated sick visit or condolence `ع و د:B005/m01`; repair after damage `ص ل ح:B001/m02`; severe illness that threatens life `ء ت ي:B011/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `غ ف ر` at 85:14; `ع و د` at 85:13; `ص ل ح` at 85:11; `ء ت ي` at 85:17.
subchannels.synthesis: Health is a reversible process: repair produces improvement, social visitation accompanies convalescence, and relapse reopens the earlier wound or disease.

subchannels.name: Eye, Gaze, and Bodily Beauty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A clear broad eye perceives at distance, while gaze, visible form, and bodily proportion generate judgments of beauty.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad clear eye `ب ر ج:B004/m01`; moving defect in the eye `ر و د:B007/m01`; distant sight `ش ي ء:B003/m01`; visible bodily handsomeness `ب ر ج:B010/m01`; diagnostic sign `ش ه د:B008/m02`; elevated visible form `س م و:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Vision and beauty are reciprocal: the eye is itself an object of beauty, detects distant form, and uses visible signs to judge condition and proportion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Living bodies mate, gestate, give birth, mature, age, suffer injury or disease, and recover through identifiable anatomical and physiological states.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the active roots occur throughout 85:3-13, but most bodily scenes arise from lexical senses rather than the surface propositions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes estrous livestock, womb contents, afterbirth, puberty, menopause, maidens, chest bones, hips, forelegs, marrow, gauntness, lung disease, infected ulcers, epidemics, relapse, and convalescence.

parent_channels.name: Animal Management, Hunting, and Mobility

subchannels.name: Herding, Livestock, and the Drove
subchannels.scene_or_process: A herder gathers dispersed animals, drives them as a unit, and manages their posture, color, and dependent burden.
subchannels.active_motifs: cattle or wild herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; gathering and driving a drove `ح و ط:B003/m01`; donkey raising its head over the herd `ع ر ش:B009/m01`; livestock wealth and dependents `ق ر ء:B013/m01`; burden or dependent `ك ل ل:B002/m01`; reddish donkey coloring `ص ح ب:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The drove is a managed collective: animals are gathered, led, observed through bodily cues, and valued as both property and burden-bearing support.

subchannels.name: Riding, Saddle, and Taming
subchannels.scene_or_process: A difficult animal is trained to submit, fitted with riding equipment, mounted, and directed by a leading limb or guide.
subchannels.active_motifs: mount and saddle `ق ع د:B008/m01`; mounting an animal `ع ر ش:B011/m01`; tractability after resistance `ص ح ب:B003/m01`; taming by repeated handling `ق ت ل:B002/m01`; leading animal or guiding limb `م ل ك:B008/m01`; leather saddle cover `ف ت ن:B008/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ق ع د` at 85:6; `ع ر ش` at 85:15; `ص ح ب` and `ق ت ل` at 85:4; `م ل ك` at 85:9; `ف ت ن` at 85:10.
subchannels.synthesis: Training changes the animal’s relation to force, equipment stabilizes the rider, and the trained body becomes a coordinated conveyance.

subchannels.name: Hunting, Scouting, and Falconry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hunters leave the settlement, scout pasture or prey, wait in concealment, and use a decoy to draw a raptor within reach.
subchannels.active_motifs: going out to hunt `س م و:B006/m01`; scouting pasture or prey `ر و د:B003/m01`; watchful ambush `ق ع د:B005/m01`; owl decoy for falconry `ل و ح:B008/m01`; animal running then stopping to look back `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`; protective watch `ح ف ظ:B004/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scouting locates the target, concealment and patience create the ambush, and the decoy manipulates the prey’s own visual attention.

subchannels.name: Gait, Cry, and Animal Signal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal condition and intention are inferred from foreleg motion, mounting posture, bellow, birdsong, and interruption of flight.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel foreleg return in gait `ء ت ي:B009/m01`; stallion’s mounting posture `س م و:B003/m01`; threatening bellow before charge `و ع د:B005/m01`; bird call or moan `ب ل ل:B010/m01`; running then halting to inspect `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`; condition marker `ش ه د:B008/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Motion and sound operate as a semiotic system: gait, cry, posture, and pause reveal readiness, aggression, fatigue, or reproductive state.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals and travelers are gathered, trained, mounted, tracked, and read through gait, cry, and bodily signal.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the relevant roots occur at 85:1, 85:4, 85:6, 85:9, 85:11, and 85:17, while the animal scenes are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes cattle drives, donkey posture, saddle covers, taming, mounted litters, hunting blinds, falcon decoys, estrous calls, camel forelegs, and pedestrians.

parent_channels.name: Labor, Craft, and Material Mechanisms

subchannels.name: Worker, Carpenter, and Crew
subchannels.scene_or_process: Skilled and manual laborers organize around construction, digging, travel, and paid work.
subchannels.active_motifs: carpenter or workman `ف ع ل:B003/m01`; hand-working crew `ع م ل:B006/m01`; pedestrian work-travelers `ع م ل:B012/m01`; wage or stipend `ع م ل:B004/m01`; assigned office of work `ع م ل:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene differentiates craft role, crew, mobility, compensation, and supervision, presenting labor as an organized social and technical system.

subchannels.name: Operation, Repair, and Application
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent applies a tool or process to repair, complete, strengthen, or activate an object.
subchannels.active_motifs: using or setting something to work `ع م ل:B002/m01`; gradual repair and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; restoration opposed to corruption `ص ل ح:B001/m02`; effect-producing action `ف ع ل:B001/m01`; material cohesion and strength `م ل ك:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Application supplies controlled action, repair supplies direction, and cohesion or completion supplies the finished state of the worked material.

subchannels.name: Timber, Rotation, Tablet, and Termite
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wood is selected, shaped into a board or rotating implement, installed in machinery, and exposed to material decay.
subchannels.active_motifs: timber or wooden implement `ع و د:B010/m01`; pivot, mill handle, or pulley axle `ر و د:B006/m01`; circular operation `ح و ط:B005/m01`; board or writing tablet `ل و ح:B003/m01`; wood-eating termite `ء ر ض:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Timber shifts roles from material to inscribed surface to moving machine part, while termite damage supplies the mechanism’s natural failure mode.

subchannels.name: Cordage, Tassel, and Ornament
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible strands are tied, hung, beaded, or arranged as decorative edging on dress, tack, or conveyance.
subchannels.active_motifs: dangling strap, cord, or tassel `ع ذ ب:B006/m01`; circular beaded ornament `ح و ط:B007/m01`; encircling crown or garland `ك ل ل:B005/m01`; woman’s ornamented litter `ع ر ش:B005/m01`; patterned decorative cloth `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The shared mechanism is flexible attachment: cords suspend, beads encircle, patterned cloth covers, and the assembled ornament marks a body or conveyance.

subchannels.name: Leather, Hair, and Material Coverings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animal skin is removed, retained with hair, used as a cover, or altered as its surface fibers shed.
subchannels.active_motifs: hide retaining hair or wool `ص ح ب:B006/m01`; leather saddle covering `ف ت ن:B008/m01`; fuzz or raised surface fibers `غ ف ر:B003/m01`; hair shedding or scorching `ح ر ق:B004/m01`; protective covering `غ ف ر:B001/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ص ح ب` at 85:4; `ف ت ن` and `ح ر ق` at 85:10; `غ ف ر` at 85:14.
subchannels.synthesis: Skin moves from body surface to worked material, while retention, shedding, and covering describe successive choices in its preparation and use.

subchannels.name: Scraping, Filing, and Surface Abrasion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard edge or surface is rubbed, filed, blunted, or visibly altered by friction.
subchannels.active_motifs: hot scraping or filing `ح ر ق:B001/m01`; wetting during abrasion `ب ل ل:B001/m02`; loss of sharpness `ك ل ل:B001/m02`; visible surface alteration `ل و ح:B002/m01`; polishing and renewal `ح د ث:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ح ر ق` at 85:10; the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `ك ل ل` at 85:9; `ل و ح` at 85:22; `ح د ث` at 85:17.
subchannels.synthesis: Friction removes material and sharpness, moisture moderates the operation, and polishing can reverse dullness by restoring a visible finish.

subchannels.name: Ship, Incendiary Vessel, and Naval Crew
subchannels.scene_or_process: A large vessel is built from planks, commanded by a captain, and equipped to project fire in combat.
subchannels.active_motifs: large warship `ب ر ج:B007/m01`; fire-bearing vessel or implement `ح ر ق:B008/m02`; ship planks `ل و ح:B003/m03`; captain of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; military pavilion or camp structure `ف و ز:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Hull material, command role, incendiary equipment, and martial encampment combine into a specific naval warfare scene.

subchannels.name: Gambling Arrows and Gaming Kit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marked lots are stored, drawn, and interpreted within a portable gaming apparatus.
subchannels.active_motifs: leather case holding gaming arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; winning lot drawn for its owner `ف و ز:B001/m02`; dangling marker or cord `ع ذ ب:B006/m01`; circular or beaded ornament `ح و ط:B007/m01`; patterned deceptive cloth `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Container, lots, markers, and decorated covering form a coherent portable kit in which a random draw is converted into an assigned outcome.

subchannels.name: Depilation, Tattooing, and Surface Marking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hair and skin are prepared, coated, pierced, darkened, or decorated to change visible bodily appearance.
subchannels.active_motifs: depilatory lime coating `ن و ر:B009/m01`; soot used for tattoo or eye cosmetic `ن و ر:B008/m01`; surface fuzz or hair `غ ف ر:B003/m01`; heat-altered skin color `ل و ح:B002/m01`; circular body ornament `ح و ط:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Removal, coating, puncture, pigment, and ornament are distinct operations within one grooming and body-marking scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Skilled agents transform materials through work, repair, rotation, cutting, binding, covering, transport, gaming apparatus, and surface treatment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: mixed; action and work at 85:7, 85:11, 85:16 and the tablet at 85:22 provide direct anchors, while most tools and materials are lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes carpenters and digging crews, mill and pulley pivots, termite-eaten timber, tassels, hairy hides, filing, incendiary ships, gambling arrows, depilatory lime, tattoo soot, and colored cloth.

parent_channels.name: Inner Stability, Attention, and Affect

subchannels.name: Security, Reliability, and Inner Calm
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fear subsides when the heart trusts a stable support and remains watchful enough to preserve that security.
subchannels.active_motifs: calm trust and reliability `ء م ن:B001/m01`; hidden heart or inner thought `ج ن ن:B010/m01`; vigilance `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`; firmness under strain `ش د د:B002/m02`; mainstay of an affair `م ل ك:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Trust settles the inner heart, a reliable mainstay grounds it, and vigilance keeps calm from becoming careless exposure.

subchannels.name: Madness and Derangement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reason, property, or self-command is covered or carried away by affliction, passion, or imagined spirit possession.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of reason `ج ن ن:B006/m01`; derangement or loss `ف ت ن:B007/m01`; passion or spirit overpowering the person `ق ت ل:B006/m01`; involuntary bodily disturbance `ء ر ض:B012/m01`; hidden spirits `ج ن ن:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ج ن ن` at 85:11; `ف ت ن` at 85:10; `ق ت ل` at 85:4; `ء ر ض` at 85:9.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene treats derangement as dispossession: an external or internal force covers reason, disturbs the body, and removes ordinary control.

subchannels.name: Will, Desire, and Attentive Listening
subchannels.scene_or_process: A desired object draws the mind, becomes a purpose, and receives focused listening or pursuit.
subchannels.active_motifs: will and intended purpose `ر و د:B001/m01`; volition `ش ي ء:B001/m01`; wished-for attainment `و د د:B002/m01`; attentive listening `ش ي ء:B005/m01`; approved or satisfying object `ح م د:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ر و د` and `ف ع ل` at 85:16; `ش ي ء` at 85:9; `و د د` at 85:14; `ح م د` at 85:8.
subchannels.synthesis: Desire identifies the object, will commits to it, attention keeps it present, and approval registers the object as worth attaining.

subchannels.name: Admiration, Pleasure, and Approval
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible or experienced object produces delight, attachment, and an enlarged estimation of its worth.
subchannels.active_motifs: admiration and pleasure `ش ي ء:B004/m01`; affective attachment `ب ل ل:B004/m02`; tested satisfaction `ح م د:B002/m01`; magnification in the heart `ك ب ر:B003/m01`; visible beauty `ب ر ج:B010/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ش ي ء` at 85:9; the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `ح م د` at 85:8; `ك ب ر` at 85:11; `ب ر ج` at 85:1.
subchannels.synthesis: Perception becomes affect when beauty enlarges the object in the observer’s estimation, producing delight and a desire to remain attached.

subchannels.name: Chastity, Shyness, and Aversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person preserves integrity by recoiling from what is indecent or threatening and guarding intimate boundaries.
subchannels.active_motifs: chaste flight from impropriety `ن و ر:B006/m01`; guarding chastity and private honor `ح ف ظ:B006/m01`; restraint from action `ع ذ ب:B003/m01`; watchful self-protection `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`; withdrawal from marriage `ق ع د:B003/m02`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ن و ر` at 85:5; `ح ف ظ` at 85:22; `ع ذ ب` at 85:10; `ق ع د` at 85:6.
subchannels.synthesis: Aversion is protective rather than passive: recoil creates distance, restraint prevents approach, and guarded boundaries preserve personal integrity.

subchannels.name: Agitation, Confusion, and Restlessness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conflicting impulses disturb the chest, language, and group, producing circular movement and inability to settle.
subchannels.active_motifs: inner and social confusion `ب ل ل:B009/m01`; interpersonal enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; warlike disturbance `ف ت ن:B006/m01`; tremor `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; restless back-and-forth motion `ر و د:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: the `بَلْ` tokens at 85:19, 85:21; `ن و ر` at 85:5; `ف ت ن` at 85:10; `ء ر ض` at 85:9; `ر و د` at 85:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Agitation is represented across scales, from bodily tremor and unsettled thought to clamorous speech and factional disturbance.

subchannels.name: Fatigue, Bluntness, and Diminished Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated use or strain dulls a blade, tongue, sense, animal, or person until performance weakens.
subchannels.active_motifs: fatigue and loss of sharpness `ك ل ل:B001/m01`; moisture and residual softness `ب ل ل:B001/m02`; blunt tongue or expression `ش ه د:B005/m02`; polishing that restores clarity `ح د ث:B007/m01`; inability to rise `ق ع د:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Dullness unifies physical and cognitive fatigue, while polishing and rest imply the possibility of recovering edge, clarity, or mobility.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The inner person moves among security, derangement, desire, admiration, aversion, agitation, and exhaustion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; belief at 85:7-11, censure at 85:8, trial at 85:10, severity at 85:12, love at 85:14, and will at 85:16 supply the surface anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel extends from trust to hidden thought, madness attributed to spirits or passion, attentive listening, aesthetic delight, chastity as flight, social turmoil as chest agitation, and dullness of tongue and perception.

parent_channels.name: Origination, Recurrence, and Temporal Transition

subchannels.name: Beginning, Creation, and Showing
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent initiates what did not exist and brings the new event into visibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning and origination `ب د ء:B001/m01`; coming into being `ح د ث:B001/m01`; disclosure and showing `ح د ث:B006/m01`; effect-producing action `ف ع ل:B001/m01`; arrival or manifestation `ء ت ي:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `ب د ء` at 85:13; `ح د ث` and `ء ت ي` at 85:17; `ف ع ل` at 85:7, 85:16.
subchannels.synthesis: Origination is both ontological and perceptual: action causes a new event, and showing completes the process by making the new state available to observers.

subchannels.name: Return, Restoration, and Homecoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: What departed or ceased comes back to its earlier state, destination, relationship, or cycle.
subchannels.active_motifs: return after departure `ع و د:B001/m01`; destination or place of return `ع و د:B002/m01`; beginning paired with restoration `ب د ء:B001/m01`; appointed return `و ع د:B003/m01`; homecoming presence `ش ه د:B001/m01`; recurring beneficial return `ع و د:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Return reverses departure but does more than repeat it: destination, appointment, and renewed benefit give recurrence a directed and restorative shape.

subchannels.name: Novelty, Freshness, and Early Stage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is perceived at the first, fresh phase of its existence before maturity or habituation.
subchannels.active_motifs: marvelous novelty `ب د ء:B002/m01`; beginning of youth or era `ج ن ن:B014/m01`; youthful freshness `ح د ث:B002/m01`; recent birth or fresh state `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; new yield or emergence `ء ت ي:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Novelty is a temporal texture shared by event, person, crop, and era: each is close enough to its beginning to retain freshness and surprise.

subchannels.name: Habit, Practice, and Constancy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repetition turns an action into a trained habit, stable method, or traceable way.
subchannels.active_motifs: habit and acquired practice `ع و د:B004/m01`; disciplined constancy `ح ف ظ:B003/m01`; customary way `ج ر ي:B002/m01`; method or model `ق ر ء:B011/m01`; gentle measured pacing `ر و د:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Repetition stabilizes both behavior and route: practice becomes habit, habit becomes method, and method leaves a reliable trace that can be followed again.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events and lives are structured by beginning, manifestation, return, novelty, habit, and restoration.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; beginning and return at 85:13, purposeful action at 85:16, and the arrival of a report at 85:17.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The temporal frame reaches creation, revelation as showing, homecoming, recurrent illness and festival, youthful freshness, habitual practice, and routes understood as repeated patterns.

parent_channels.name: S1. Proverbial Thief and Serpent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A proverbial danger scene pairs a named thief with a concealed serpent and the compact wisdom of a fire proverb.
parent_channels.active_motifs: thief named in proverb `ب ر ج:B012/m01`; serpent or white snake `ج ن ن:B012/m01`; proverbial abundance of fire in suitable wood `م ج د:B005/m02`; hidden danger `ج ن ن:B001/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Theft, concealment, serpent danger, and proverbial fire form a compact cautionary image whose relation is figurative rather than part of the broader social or animal scenes.

parent_channels.name: S2. Camp Pavilion and Portable Provision
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A temporary camp combines a military pavilion, mounted litter, leather covering, and compact sweet provision.
parent_channels.active_motifs: military pavilion `ف و ز:B004/m01`; woman’s mounted litter `ع ر ش:B005/m01`; leather saddle cover `ف ت ن:B008/m01`; honey retained in wax `ش ه د:B007/m01`; water securing the encampment `م ل ك:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Shelter, conveyance, leather equipment, concentrated food, and water make a coherent portable camp scene that does not reduce to warfare, hospitality, or craft alone.
